data.name: C_VersionNoticeText
data.value: Avalonia migration is in progress. No new features are planned for now; the focus is performance and bug fixes. Look forward to v3 on the Avalonia architecture! Report bugs through GitHub Issues or the SECTL QQ group - 833875216

data.name: S_Behavior_Autostart_D
data.value: Start the software automatically with the system

data.name: S_Behavior_ShowStartupWindow_D
data.value: Automatically show the main window when the software starts

data.name: S_Behavior_MainWindowTopmostMode_D
data.value: Choose how the main window stays on top (UIAccess requests administrator permission on restart; cancellation or failure falls back to ordinary topmost for this launch)

data.name: S_Behavior_BackgroundResident_D
data.value: Keep running in the background after all windows close

data.name: S_Behavior_UrlProtocol_D
data.value: Register secrandom:// and enable IPC for link activation and external integration

data.name: S_Behavior_Language_D
data.value: Switch the interface language (takes effect after restart)

data.name: S_Behavior_CrashRecovery_D
data.value: Choose how to recover after a program crash

data.name: O_CrashRecoveryMode_PromptAndRestart
data.value: Show recovery page and restart automatically
